name: CRPG
description: A party of interlocking builds fighting tactical encounters, talking through branching dialogue where stats open doors, and living with consequences factions remember. The spine is dialogue_tree_engine wired to attribute_sheet and reputation_system: words are mechanics here, not decoration.
loop: party of builds → tactical encounters → dialogue choices → branching story

signatureCompound.name: Branching Encounter
signatureCompound.description: Walk the party in under party_formation, talk through dialogue_tree_engine with attribute_sheet rolling the checks, and let reputation_system plus the quest log turn the outcome into standing the next quest gate reads. Combat is optional; consequence is not.
